captions.text: Every job asks for something a little different.
Job Explorer tailors your resume to each one, using only your own experience.
Start from a job in your Review List, and click tailor resume.
They're all single-column with standard headings, so applicant tracking systems can read them.
The AI chooses which parts of your experience to lead with for this job, and may reword them lightly.
Anything that would add a fact you haven't approved is put back to your own wording, so it never makes up experience.
With local AI, writing takes a couple of minutes.
The draft is ready, along with a summary of what the AI did.
Every change comes with a reason, tied to what the job asks for.
You can see exactly why your resume looks the way it does.
You can edit any line, or remove it.
Titles, dates, and contact details always come from your Profile.
Then export it as a Word file or a PDF, ready to upload.
And approve it when it looks right.
Get it on the Microsoft Store.
